acceptance.boundaries: Thresholds are prospective engineering policy, not measured results. Reject tiny or noisy improvements; use full-phase makespan to ensure the gain survives VALID/save/export overhead. At most one repeat when ambiguous.
acceptance.formula: sum_i (paired_work_i/common_overlap_seconds)/(solo_work_i/solo_seconds_i); pair times must be identical and both jobs active throughout

candidate_pair_order.reason: Both host51 lifecycle branches and ongoing completed-pilot resource/time traces can be reused; no new broad lifecycle grid
Reuse exact MolHIV whole-epoch branch where applicable; pair only after each exact host51 profile has a measured mature process envelope
Reuse passed whole-epoch native lifecycles; measured5GB and27GB priors make mixed placement plausible but do not prove speedup or current host51 envelope

measured_resource_priors.limits: Pilot sample is not an exact maximum; short lifecycle RSS/allocator observations are separate
measured_resource_priors.sample_kind: nvidia-smi current sample during mature pilot

measured_resource_priors.limits: Mature total-process observation must attach from completed structured pilot before pair admission

measured_resource_priors.profile: MolHIV GIN-VN conditional input shared on allocation
measured_resource_priors.sample_kind: one complete native TRAIN epoch plus two VALID

measured_resource_priors.limits: 40GiB historical repair reservation is not observed demand; source/host applicability still required
Reserved allocator peak is not total process VRAM; use process sample/envelope before paired placement
measured_resource_priors.profile: NCNC input conditional lifecycle on allocation
measured_resource_priors.sample_kind: two epochs and fresh selected restore

prerequisites: All frozen PubMed workers terminal and drained; no source/map/HEAD mutations during pilots
Exact successor release, physical host/phase, source/descriptor hashes and ownership admission supplied by portability work
Current own and peer PID/start-tick identities, GPU UUID, per-process memory, host/cgroup RAM and disk; snapshots do not reserve capacity
Provider closure and native imports applicable to selected family; existing functional lifecycle evidence accepted only with explicit source/branch applicability
Engineering task IDs, disjoint output paths, fixed seeds, unchanged native data/sampler/precision/optimizer/validation work, finite epoch/update and wall limits fixed before starting
procedure: Bind exact canonical representatives and engineering outputs after frozen pilots drain; no campaign task is marked complete by engineering work
Attach same-source solo lifecycle/resource evidence already available. Only measure missing comparable solo throughput A and B with identical CPU/runtime settings and complete native work
Run one paired phase on one admitted physical GPU UUID; sample own PID/start-tick GPU/RSS/CPU/IO and device/host/disk each second, plus allocator peaks at native phase boundaries

Record common interval while both children are active, excluding construction/warmup, and completed native work within it; also report full-phase makespan including construction/VALID/save/export overhead

Record 3 progress subwindows where work duration permits; for full-epoch molecular/link blocks count native updates as work and also verify whole epoch completion. A short last window is not promoted to mature throughput
Optional fourth phase only to resolve a borderline speedup or changed startup ordering; maximum two paired attempts, no automatic retries beyond that bound

Stop launches at finite limit. Finish only the already-started bounded native unit if safe. On OOM/identity/resource failure preserve failure/partial-work receipts and revert pair to one child; never terminate peers
Accept only named pair/profile/UUID/source/package/thread tuple. Other presets/methods remain one child until measured or covered by an explicit justified resource/throughput envelope

resource_rule.CPU: Freeze threads/interop/affinity and record them for solo and pair. No opportunistic per-job thread changes between phases. Monitor utilization and IO wait.
resource_rule.GPU: Fresh free bytes, after peers, must cover sum of measured mature per-process peaks plus per-job allowance max(20% peak,1GiB), plus4GiB device safety headroom. Use total-process observations; allocator reserve alone does not close this gate.
resource_rule.RAM: Use min(MemAvailable,cgroup headroom if limited), account aggregate active own RSS, native provider/cache growth, peer growth and8GiB host floor; RSS-only arithmetic does not bound page cache.
resource_rule.disk: Use admission.py incremental disk/retained-cap decision; active two-checkpoint+atomic-temporary+export+log growth must be budgeted.
invalidations: peer identities or growth outside admitted envelope

reuse: SERVER51_QUALIFICATION_RESULTS native/structured fresh restore bit-exact checks
NCNC v6 CUDA lifecycle where successor component bindings establish applicability
Frozen PubMed complete-pilot selected/export/resource traces when drained
